Sketchbook

Meu nome é Lucca, sou storyboard artist brasileiro e tenho paixão por projetos de animação, sejam eles em 2D, 3D ou stop motion.

Sketchbook

My name is Lucca, I'm a Brazilian storyboard artist with a passion for animated projects, be it 2D, 3D or stop motion.

I have a special interest in dynamic and action-oriented projects, and I love including my own passion in every project I work on.

My experience ranges from children's series to cautionary tales and bank robberies, so feel free to reach out about the stories you're looking to see on paper.
